text: 据中国摩托车商会消息，根据海关数据统计分析，2026年1—9月，我国摩托车整车出口量为1516.36万辆，较去年同期增长11.76%，出口额为102.87亿美元，较去年同期增长21.19%。其中：非洲出口量最多，涨幅最大，出口量为572.21万辆，同比增长32.05%，出口额为31.95亿美元，同比增长38.60%。2026年1—9月，我国摩托车整车进口量为5.40万辆，较去年同期增长11.39%，进口额为2.93亿美元，较去年同期增长10.93%。
text_en: According to the China Chamber of Commerce for Motorcycle, based on customs data analysis, from January to September 2026, China's exports of complete motorcycles totaled 15.1636 million units, up 11.76% from the same period last year, with export value of US$10.287 billion, up 21.19% from the same period last year. Among them: Africa had the largest export volume and the largest increase, with exports of 5.7221 million units, up 32.05% year on year, and export value of US$3.195 billion, up 38.60% year on year. From January to September 2026, China's imports of complete motorcycles totaled 54,000 units, up 11.39% from the same period last year, with import value of US$293 million, up 10.93% from the same period last year.
